continue to dictate crypto flows as the US 10Y yield climbs 5.1bp to 5.154 percent and the DXY edges up to 103.41. Risk assets are consolidating as market participants weigh tightening financial conditions against the backdrop of recent tech sector volatility.

Bitcoin & Ether
Bitcoin trades at 63,823, down 0.48 percent today and 13.7 percent over the week, maintaining a fragile structure near multi-week lows. Ethereum holds at 1,775.83, registering a 0.38 percent daily gain and an ETH/BTC ratio of 0.02782.

Altcoins
Alternative assets display mild intraday relief but remain under heavy weekly pressure, with only 4 out of 10 tracked alts beating Bitcoin over the past seven days. Zcash leads weekly performance down 7.8 percent at 890.97, while Solana lags as the worst weekly performer down 16.4 percent at 69.66.
